about: Golden sets for ProactiveAgent's three checks, each with false-positive cases. conflict: one new decision and one earlier candidate (check_decision; 12 cases carried over from proactive_conflict_golden.json plus 8 harder negatives). workload: the assignee's open action count against PROACTIVE_WORKLOAD_THRESHOLD=6 (check_action, no model). stakeholder: a window, the stakeholder gate's answer, the KG's earlier decisions on the topic and who attended which meeting (check_window). People are keys; the harness gives each a UUID.

stakeholder.note: Rewritten after the first live eval (2026-11-11). The case tests the silent band: pricing clearly discussed, nothing settled. Its old text ('Maybe pricing for the add-on, not sure it matters yet.' / 'Could be later.') was a hedged one-line mention, which the stakeholder prompt (v2 and v3 alike) says to score low ('not just mentioning a word once'); Haiku scored it 0.3 to 0.5, so the case measured coin flips around the 0.5 gate, not the band. The new text is an unsettled discussion of the same item.
